title: DOX
description: News and releases of Dox, the web backend framework for Dart.

items.title: What makes Dox fast
items.content_html: Dox is fast because your Dart code runs as a compiled binary, the network and database work happens in native code on the same thread, and most of the setup...

items.title: Dox vs Node.js: memory and speed
items.content_html: In our published benchmark on 2 CPU cores, a Dox app served more requests per second than a Node.js app and used much less memory.

items.title: A tour of Dox features
items.content_html: This post is a short tour of the parts that come with Dox, from routing and validation to the ORM, login, queues, mail and the CLI.

items.title: Build a Dart API with Dox
items.content_html: This post shows how to go from an empty folder to a tested API with a database, validation and a native binary, in a few short steps.

items.title: Dox 3.1 is out
items.content_html: Dox 3.1 adds new routing tools, request helpers, new ORM features, access tokens, a new MCP package, mail and queue features, and many security and bug fixes.
